translation: The chin bone (地閣骨) is the bone where the two jaws intersect, also called the chin (頦), commonly called the lower jaw bone (下巴骨); it carries the teeth above. If injured by a fall or blow, with the cheeks and lips swollen and painful, the jaw vibrating and deficient and floating, food and drink not taken in, the eyes closed and the spirit dazed, the heart hot and the spirit disordered, the qi weak and the body soft, use cloth to wrap and bind it tied to the top of the head, internally take Da Shen Xiao Huo Luo Dan (大神效活絡丹) to disperse stasis, stop pain, harmonize blood, regulate qi, and strengthen the spleen; then hold Ren Shen Zi Jin Dan (人參紫金丹) in the mouth to dissolve it, rub on Gu Chi San (固齒散), rinse the mouth with Bi Bo San (蓽茇散) to remove swelling and pain of the tooth roots, and externally stick Wan Ling Ointment (萬靈膏).
